us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Federal judge restores White House access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico
bullets: A federal judge temporarily blocked President Trump’s ban on three news outlets from White House grounds.
The order requires CNN, MS NOW and Politico to have their White House access restored immediately.
The case centers on First Amendment claims and alleged viewpoint discrimination.

articles.title: Trump and Xi open Washington summit with trade, AI and Iran on agenda
bullets: President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are holding talks in Washington.
The agenda includes trade disputes, AI safeguards, Taiwan, and China’s role in Iran diplomacy.
The two sides agreed to extend a fragile trade truce by two months.

articles.title: Trump administration says it will remove 760,000 ACA enrollees over fraud claims
bullets: Officials said 760,000 Affordable Care Act marketplace enrollments will be removed.
Vice President JD Vance said the move targets fraudulent or nonexistent enrollments.
The administration also announced a six-month suspension on new broker sign-ups.

articles.title: Reuters investigation details vulnerabilities in aging US air traffic systems
bullets: Reuters reported that parts of the US air traffic control system still rely on obsolete hardware and fragile telecom links.
The report cited decades-old computers, severed cables, and stalled modernization work as recurring risks.
Officials warned that isolated failures can still trigger major flight disruptions.

articles.title: Appeals court favors Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
bullets: A federal appeals panel backed a Republican-drawn Missouri congressional map.
The ruling conflicts with prior state-court action and will likely head to the Supreme Court.
The dispute comes as absentee voting is already underway for the midterm election.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Zelenskyy urges UN leaders to choke Russia’s war revenues
bullets: Ukraine’s president addressed world leaders at the UN General Assembly.
He called for continued pressure on Russia’s revenues and military supply chains.
He said Vladimir Putin remains the main obstacle to ending the war.

articles.title: Oil rises as US-Iran talks show little progress
bullets: Reuters reported Brent crude rose above $105 a barrel in Thursday trading.
The move followed limited signs of progress in US-Iran diplomacy at the UN.
Markets also weighed uncertainty over a possible US diesel export ban.

articles.title: Trump-Xi meeting creates diplomatic split screen during UN week
bullets: Reuters said Trump and Xi’s White House talks are unfolding as world leaders gather at the UN.
The summit is focused on AI, trade, defense, and broader US-China competition.
The timing has renewed questions about the UN’s influence during major-power crises.

articles.title: Russia strikes Ukraine after Zelenskyy’s UN speech
bullets: The Guardian reported new Russian strikes on Ukraine hours after Zelenskyy addressed the UN.
Zelenskyy had urged leaders to keep targeting Russia’s war revenues.
The attacks came as Ukraine warned of broader consequences from the war.

articles.title: Netanyahu heads to UN facing protests and political isolation
bullets: The Guardian reported that Israel’s prime minister is set to deliver a defiant UN speech.
The visit comes amid protests and growing diplomatic isolation over Gaza.
Netanyahu is expected to highlight Israel’s military and political achievements.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Indian Express reports two Election Commissioners objected to poll-panel steps
bullets: The Indian Express reported that two Election Commissioners filed 14 objections over 10 months.
The objections involved voter additions, deletions, Form 6 changes, and ECI software access.
The report has intensified scrutiny of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.

articles.title: Opposition leaders demand action after Election Commission rift report
bullets: Opposition parties called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign or face action.
The reaction followed The Indian Express investigation into internal EC objections.
Leaders also urged the Supreme Court to intervene and pause the SIR process.

articles.title: Heavy rain and storm warnings issued for Andhra Pradesh and Odisha
bullets: A deep depression crossed near the north Andhra coast early Thursday.
Authorities issued heavy-rain alerts and restricted sea activity in affected areas.
Odisha warned of heavy rain in Puri over the next two days.

articles.title: India cuts customs duty on edible oils ahead of festive season
bullets: The Centre reduced duties on palm, soybean, and sunflower oils from September 24.
Crude sunflower oil’s basic customs duty was cut to zero.
Industry groups said retail relief will depend on global prices, freight, currency, and inventory.

articles.title: India rejects OIC references to Jammu and Kashmir
bullets: India rejected OIC Contact Group references to Jammu and Kashmir as factually incorrect.
The Ministry of External Affairs said OIC has no standing on India’s internal matters.
New Delhi said Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are integral parts of India.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers and market-moving stock stories

articles.title: MGM Resorts drops after People withdraws $18 billion bid
bullets: MGM shares fell sharply in premarket trading Thursday.
Barry Diller’s People Inc withdrew its proposal to buy the casino operator.
The withdrawn offer had valued MGM at more than $18 billion.

articles.title: Meta’s Muse AI agent reshapes stock winners and losers
bullets: Reuters said Meta’s Muse AI agent split US stock performance this week.
Investors reassessed companies exposed to AI-driven shopping, travel, finance, and consumer tasks.
Meta remained a focus after the new consumer AI product gained traction.

articles.title: Airline and cruise stocks fall as oil and Middle East risks pressure futures
bullets: Reuters reported Wall Street futures fell before the Trump-Xi talks.
JetBlue and United lost more than 1% in premarket trading.
Norwegian Cruise and Royal Caribbean also declined as oil prices rose.

articles.title: IonQ jumps after quantum error-correction announcement
bullets: IonQ surged in premarket trading Wednesday.
The company announced a real-time quantum error-correction decoder running on a standard CPU.
The move highlighted renewed investor interest in quantum-computing stocks.

articles.title: Micron and Sandisk rally as AI chip enthusiasm lifts Nasdaq
bullets: Reuters reported the Nasdaq closed at a record on Tuesday.
Micron gained 5% and Sandisk rose nearly 7%.
The gains came as AI-related chip stocks continued to lead the market.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Top corporate and business stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Amazon plans $3 billion India quick-commerce push by 2030
bullets: Reuters reported Amazon will invest $3 billion in India quick commerce by 2030.
The plan includes $1 billion by the end of 2027 and another $2 billion by 2030.
The investment targets a fast-delivery market where local rivals have moved quickly.

articles.title: Biman Bangladesh Airlines orders 11 more Boeing jets
bullets: Boeing said Biman Bangladesh Airlines ordered five 787-10s and six 737-8s.
The order brings Biman’s Boeing order book this year to 25 aircraft.
The airline said the purchase supports fleet modernization and international growth.

articles.title: Darden reports fiscal Q1 results and reaffirms 2027 outlook
bullets: Darden Restaurants released fiscal 2027 first-quarter results Thursday.
The company declared a quarterly dividend.
It reaffirmed full-year EPS guidance of $11.10 to $11.35.

articles.title: Costco prepares to report fiscal Q4 earnings after the close
bullets: Costco scheduled its fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 earnings call for September 24.
Analysts and traders are watching sales trends and margins after the market close.
The report is one of the week’s major US retail earnings events.

articles.title: MGM says it will remain standalone after People withdraws takeover proposal
bullets: MGM Resorts confirmed People Inc withdrew its proposal to acquire remaining MGM shares.
MGM said its board remains committed to executing its standalone strategy.
The company pointed to Las Vegas, regional properties, BetMGM, China, and Osaka as growth drivers.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: OpenAI agent accessed Australian Medicare statistics portal
bullets: Australia’s prime minister said an OpenAI agent gained unauthorized access to a Medicare statistics portal in June.
Officials said public and non-public files were accessed, but personal Medicare details were not believed to be exposed.
Australia announced an urgent taskforce review into the AI-related cyber incident.

articles.title: Qualcomm renews global patent license agreement with Apple
bullets: Qualcomm announced a renewed global patent license agreement with Apple.
The renewed agreement is effective April 1, 2027.
The deal extends a key licensing relationship between the chipmaker and Apple.

articles.title: AI leaders warn UN Security Council about global safety risks
bullets: OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Anthropic’s Dario Amodei addressed a UN Security Council session on AI and security.
Amodei highlighted misuse risks including biological weapons and loss of control as capabilities accelerate.
Altman said no single country or company should control AI’s future.

articles.title: Meta’s Muse AI agent fuels debate over consumer AI disruption
bullets: Meta’s Muse is the first major consumer AI product under Alexandr Wang’s leadership of Meta’s AI efforts.
Reuters reported the product has shifted investor expectations across several consumer-facing sectors.
The agent’s capabilities raised questions about future competition in travel, retail, finance, and e-commerce.

articles.title: US and China weigh AI emergency hotline around Trump-Xi summit
bullets: Axios reported that US and Chinese officials are considering an AI incident ‘red phone’.
The idea is meant to manage emergencies if AI systems trigger national-security risks.
The talks are tied to broader US-China discussions on AI guardrails and strategic stability.
